title: Offline edits are lost after reconnecting to network
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in FieldNotes, the user encountered: Offline edits are lost after reconnecting to network.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Offline mode
2. Observe UI state: Back online
3. Observe UI state: Sync failed

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Sync failed.

## Environment
- App: FieldNotes
- Platform: ios
